objects.say: The last of the king's birds comes down for good.^Behind you a grille lifts. In the corner, another: something small and bronze is in a chest behind it.

objects.say: The last of the king's birds comes down for good.^Behind you a grille lifts. In the corner, another: something small and bronze is in a chest behind it.

objects.text: {g}'THE KING'S ROAD. NONE WALK IT TWICE.'{/}^Under it, in a thief's charcoal: {g}'Abba went up. Abba has not come down. We are not going up.'{/}
{g}'ALL REQUESTS FOR THE KEY ARE TO BE MADE IN WRITING.'{/}^{g}'ALL WRITING IS TO BE HANDED TO THE STEWARD.'{/}| {g}'THE STEWARD IS NOT TO BE DISTURBED.'{/}

A post, and a rope as thick as your wrist made fast to it.^The rope goes out over the drop to the top of the drawbridge. Cut it and the bridge comes down.| It is a long way out for a blade. Not for something thrown.
{g}'THE STEWARD OF THE HOUSE RECEIVES NOBODY.'{/}^{g}'THIS IS NOT PERSONAL. HE RECEIVED NOBODY WHEN HE WAS ALIVE.'{/}
on:t3_weight
objects.say: With nothing holding it down, the grille in front of the steward's chest goes up.^He watches it go. He has the look of a man whose filing has been disturbed.

objects.text: ghostkey
A stone coffin, lid on.^From inside, the sound of fingers drumming.~~In the dream it is only a stone box.~~A stone coffin, lid on.^From inside: nothing at all. Bliss.
A bronze perch, a spear's length high. The bar is wound with hide, for talons.^Whatever sits on it is not small, and has not been fed.
{g}'EAST: THE KING'S BIRDS. NORTH: THE KING.'{/}^{g}'WEST: THE STEWARD, BY APPOINTMENT.'{/}| There is no way west from here. That is how you get an appointment.
{g}'THE KING IS WITHIN. HE HAS BEEN WITHIN FOR FOUR HUNDRED YEARS.'{/}^{g}'KNOCK, AND IT WILL BE HELD AGAINST YOU.'{/}
A king's treasure, heaped where the bearers set it down.^You are the night watch. You are the one man in Ashkel who can't.

gong:t3_gong
objects.say: The gong on its island sings.^In the corner, a grille lifts. The old bird does not look round. It has heard gongs.
